name: intruder
label: Intruder
description: Intruder is a powerful vulnerability management platform that helps businesses identify, assess, and remediate security risks across their digital assets. With its comprehensive scanning capabilities and user-friendly interface, Intruder enables organizations to stay ahead of potential threats and maintain a robust security posture.

token.label: Intruder API Key
token.description: API Key for Intruder. Get it from your Intruder account.

addTarget.label: Add Target
addTarget.description: Add a new target to your Intruder account

address.label: Target Address
address.description: The address or domain of the target (e.g., example.com, 192.168.1.1)

tags.label: Tags
tags.description: Tags to organize and filter targets

startScan.label: Start Scan
startScan.description: Start a new scan. Optionally specify target addresses and/or tag names. If no targets or tags are provided, the scan will run on all targets.

target_addresses.label: Target Addresses
target_addresses.description: Target addresses to scan (e.g., example.com, 192.168.1.1). Leave empty to scan all targets.

tag_names.label: Tag Names
tag_names.description: Tag names to filter targets. Leave empty to scan all targets.

address.label: Target Address
address.description: The address or domain to search for (e.g., example.com, 192.168.1.1)

searchForAnIssue.label: Search For an Issue
searchForAnIssue.description: Search for issues with optional filters

searchForAnIssueOccurrence.label: Search For an Issue Occurrence
searchForAnIssueOccurrence.description: Search for occurrences of an issue by ID with optional snoozed filter

issueId.label: Issue ID
issueId.description: The ID of the issue to search for occurrences
